title: cyanus thirkei
intro: Cyanus thirkei, commonly known as cornflower, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of cornflower include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote a good night's sleep. Bioactive constituents of cornflower include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
